Title: Source 4: The Caddo
Content: This drawing shows members of the Caddo tribe building a hut at Poverty Point in Louisiana. The Caddo lived in villages they built around mounds. Archeologists¹ believe the Caddo may have used these mounds for religious ceremonies.
The Caddo grew their food. They also hunted and fished. The Caddo used tools like those in the picture to cut down trees and chop wood.
